title: Rep. Rick Larsen Disclosed 4 Stock Trades: Home Depot, FedEx, ADI and Williams-Sonoma
content:
Rep. Rick Larsen (WA-2) disclosed four stock trades on October 12, 2026, all dated October 8: purchases of Williams-Sonoma and Analog Devices, and sales of Home Depot and FedEx, each in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

DateTickerCompanyType / sizePrice at trade vs. Nov 2 (Bargo est.)
Oct 8ADIAnalog Devices, Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$405.93 vs. $412.85 (+1.70%)
Oct 8WSMWilliams-Sonoma, Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$239.00 vs. $259.45 (+8.56%)
Oct 8FDXFedEx CorporationSale, $1,001–$15,000$291.73 vs. $318.25 (+9.09%)
Oct 8HDHome Depot, Inc.Sale, $1,001–$15,000$295.47 vs. $341.15 (+15.46%)

Transaction date for all four: Oct 8, 2026. Disclosure date: Oct 12, 2026 (4 days later). Member: Rep. Rick Larsen, WA-2 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • Two purchases: Analog Devices (ADI) and Williams-Sonoma (WSM), $1,001–$15,000 each.
  • Two sales: FedEx (FDX) and Home Depot (HD), $1,001–$15,000 each.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts all four higher on November 2 than on October 8: Home Depot about 15.5%, FedEx about 9.1%, Williams-Sonoma about 8.6% and Analog Devices about 1.7%.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
4 days after the trades, which were all dated October 8. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 2 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.

Trade data from Bargo (STOCK Act filings). This post is our own summary of public filings and is not investment advice. See our Disclaimer and evidence labels.
